messages.subject: Re: Cap reached: plan review 3 of 3 has 10 blocking findings; need your decision before implementing
messages.body: USER DECISION (2026-11-02 08:41 UTC): add all 10 open blocking findings (B3-01 to B3-10) to the plan and implement it. No fourth plan review. Safeguard, required before implementing: (1) run ONE fixed, recorded search (git grep -n -i over src/, plugins/, commands/, agents/, templates and the root twins) for every wording of the old rule: 'any severity', 'of any severity', 'FAIL: Issues found', 'strictly fewer issues', 'logged for human review', 'minor issues still pass', 'zero tolerance', fix-agent triggers on minors-only or any-remaining-issue lists, and fix-cycle caps above 2. Save the exact pattern list and every hit to .dev/review-severity-rule/site-sweep.md, and give each hit a plan task or a written reason it is not a rule of this kind. (2) Add a static test that fails if any of those wordings survive as a rule anywhere in those trees, so a missed site fails CI. (3) Fix B3-09 by giving acceptance checks text anchors instead of line numbers. Per-task QA and the FINAL review stay as they are, each under the 2-fix-cycle cap. Then tests, commit, push and /sc:pr-submit --monitor 3 as in your spec.
